keyEvents.text: Sam Perry (Alvechurch) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Plymouth Argyle 1, Alvechurch 0. Will Evans (Plymouth Argyle) left footed shot from the right side of the box to the bottom left corner following a fast break.
Alex Hartridge (Plymouth Argyle) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Danny Newton (Alvechurch) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Plymouth Argyle 2, Alvechurch 0. Will Evans (Plymouth Argyle) right footed shot from the left side of the six yard box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Ronan Curtis.
Jared Robert Christopher Rendle (Plymouth Argyle) Substitution at 71'
Goal! Plymouth Argyle 3, Alvechurch 0. Michael Baidoo (Plymouth Argyle) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Jared Rendle.
Goal! Plymouth Argyle 4, Alvechurch 0. Ronan Curtis (Plymouth Argyle) left footed shot from the left side of the box to the high centre of the goal. Assisted by Harvey White.
